name: Desert Time Mugen no Meikyuu
original_name: デザートタイム 夢幻の迷宮
source:
One day a huge mystery dungeon appeared in the middle of the desert. A number of hidden treasures were discovered there and the rumor spread all over the world. 
As you step inside, you are challenged by girl wizard. A huge explosion occurs and everyone got sucked under the sand. Now you need to get back to ground floor and maybe even further.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
某天，一座巨大的神秘迷宮出現在沙漠中央。人們在裡頭發現許多寶藏，消息很快就傳遍了全世界。你踏入後，受到一名女魔法師挑戰。巨大的爆炸發生，所有人都被吸入沙中。現在，你必須回到地面，甚至可能繼續深入。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
